tools.name: get_llc_options
tools.description: Returns the three US LLC formation packages offered by Start Companies, with price, turnaround time and what each one includes, plus add-on services, annual renewals and tax advisory. Call this before discussing prices, renewals, advisory or what is included.

tools.name: recommend_llc_package
tools.description: Given the US state, whether the LLC has more than one member, and which services the user needs, returns the package that matches those inputs and explains why. Read-only: it does not create anything.

tools.name: create_llc_lead
tools.description: Registers the LLC formation request, emails the user a confirmation with their reference number, and returns the payment link. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_order_status" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Looks up a previously submitted LLC formation request and returns its status. Requires BOTH the reference number (format SC-MMDD-XXXX) and the email address use…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_renewal_info, get_order_status · Private data: get_itin_info · Public sink: create_llc_lead, get_renewal_info, get_itin_info, get_order_status · Destructive: get_order_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_renewal_info, get_order_status · Private data: get_itin_info · Public sink: create_llc_lead, get_renewal_info, get_itin_info, get_order_status · Destructive: get_order_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
